summary: Completed comprehensive testing of dropdown menu z-index issue in /pagamentos page. CRITICAL BUG CONFIRMED: Overlay is intercepting pointer events, making dropdown menu buttons unclickable despite correct z-index values. Backend APIs are fully functional.

ui_bugs.component: Dropdown Menu in Parcelas Pendentes Table
ui_bugs.issue: Overlay intercepts pointer events preventing dropdown menu interaction
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot click on dropdown menu options (Registrar Pagamento, Enviar WhatsApp, Excluir Parcela)

technical_details.root_cause: Overlay div with 'fixed inset-0' intercepts pointer events despite lower z-index

reproduction_steps: 5. Try to hover/click on dropdown options
6. Observe that overlay intercepts all pointer events

passed_tests: Dropdown menu visual appearance (z-index 110 applied correctly)
Click outside to close menu functionality

success_percentage.frontend: 20% - Dropdown menu visually works but functionally broken due to pointer event interception

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL FIX REQUIRED: The overlay div in Pagamentos.js (lines 514-519) is intercepting pointer events and preventing dropdown menu interaction. Recommended fixes: 1) Add 'pointer-events: none' to overlay and handle clicks differently, 2) Move dropdown outside overlay DOM hierarchy, or 3) Use event.stopPropagation() on dropdown clicks. The z-index values are correct (dropdown: 110, overlay: 100) but pointer event handling is broken.
